item.title: Anetomo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY
  • 発売日: 2022-08-26
  • スコア: 7.55/10 (197 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アネトモ
  • 英語名: Anetomo

あらすじ

The protagonist who’s always being teased by his sister ends up in the same school as her and their childhood friend, Shinoa, and he’s being forced into their literature club.

However the club is in danger if they dont win the next summer competition. Otherwise the club will be abolished.

In exchange for making the protagonist do the work, the girls all help out by giving him some extra services. Meanwhile Eimi, the protagonist older sister, declared war against the other girls and wont let them have her brother.

item.title: Nee Nee Nee
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY
  • 発売日: 2021-08-27
  • スコア: 7.709999999999999/10 (196 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ねぇねぇ姉
  • 英語名: Nee Nee Nee

别名

  • ne-♡ne-♡sister

あらすじ

Kusukuni Takashi, a student short for his age with a youthful face, has always been treated like a little brother by his cousin Takasu Yoshika, his dentist Amamiya Imari, and the massage parlor employee Nagaoka Rito. They constantly pamper and tease him.

However, it comes to light that Imari and Rito have been scheming to monopolize Takashi and take his chastity. Yoshika, determined to protect her cousin, and Imari and Rito, driven by their desire to make Takashi their own, begin making bold advances toward him every day.

item.title: Mama×Holic ~Miwaku no Mama to Ama Ama Kankei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY
  • 発売日: 2020-09-25
  • スコア: 8.43/10 (512 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Mama×Holic ～魅惑のママと甘々カンケイ～
  • 英語名: Mama×Holic Miwaku no Mama to Ama Ama Kankei

あらすじ

By a strange turn of events, Amano Taichi has become the one that possesses the “magic element of awakening” that all demi-humans seek.

Taichi is to use this power to awaken the demi-humans Kuon, Suzuka, and Seira to their latent abilities by having sex with them every day, but an accident puts the entire school in a coma!

item.title: Nee-chan no Susume ~Onee-chan no Itazura Seiseikatsu~
item.description:

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY

  • スコア: 7.74/10 (394 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姉ちゃんのススメ～お姉ちゃんのイタズラ性生活～
  • 英語名: Nee-chan no Susume Onee-chan no Itazura Seiseikatsu

あらすじ

The protagonist Natsuno Shinji spends his days helping his sister, Ai’s coffee shop while attending school. However, the situation changed completely when he became friends with a popular school girl, Matsunaga Shigure!

Natsuno Ai, an extreme brocon and Kamiya Aoba, his childhood friend misunderstood Shigure to be Shinji’s girlfriend. To take back Shinji, they start teaching him naughty things.

item.title: Love×Holic ~Miwaku no Otome to Hakudaku Kankei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY
  • 発売日: 2018-05-25
  • スコア: 7.859999999999999/10 (421 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Love×Holic ～魅惑の乙女と白濁カンケイ～
  • 英語名: Love×Holic Miwaku no Otome to Hakudaku Kankei

あらすじ

In a world where humans and demi-humans coexist, Amano Taichi has by accident drank some blood of Aoe Kuon, the most popular girl in the school. Drinking her blood changed his body to have a special constitution which awakens demi-humans.

In exchange for protecting Taichi from whoever would target him, the Aoe house made him cooperate with awakening Kuon…

item.title: Shigokare ~Ecchi na Joshi Daisei to Doki x2 Love Lesson!!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 7.790000000000001/10 (235 人評価)
  • 日本語名: しごカレ ～エッチな女子大生とドキ×２ラブレッスン！！～
  • 英語名: Shigokare Ecchi na Joshi Daisei to Doki x2 Love Lesson!!

あらすじ

The protagonist miraculously recovers from an incurable disease, however, he still suffers a considerable drop in mental and physical ability. Moreover, his school suddenly announces an exam which, if he can’t pass it, will get him expelled immediately.

Through the help of his doctor, he is introduced to several private tutors, but all of them are female college students. Furthermore, he needs to study at their dormitory and university. And so, his dorm life​ filled with private ecchi lessons begins.

item.title: Chu x Pet
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Kaguya BARE & BUNNY

  • 日本語名: CHU×ペット
  • 英語名: Chu x Pet

别名

  • Chu! Pet

あらすじ

The protagonist is a high school student whose life changes drastically when one day his mother tells him a man has proposed to her and she asks for his blessing. Being raised entirely by his mother he accepts so she can be happy.

Then the day he finally meets his new family he shockingly finds out his new sister is the school’s student council president and popular student Sakuya, as he now forms part of the Aotsuki family.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: なまイキ～生粋荘へようこそ！～
  • 英語名: Namaiki Kissuisou e Youkoso!

别名

  • なまイキ ～生粋荘（きっすいそう）へようこそ！～

あらすじ

Main protagonist Satoshi Ashifuji is a working student attending university under a scholarship.

Somehow, he ends up with the custody of the dormitory Kissuisou, but its residents are all women with big problems!

Furthermore, when fixing the dorm’s clock tower, a self-proclaimed Zashiki-warashi who calls herself Ibaraki appears, beckoning even more trouble.
